info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-fulfillment-dotnet-api-Delete Api Product By Product Id-v1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint facilitates the removal of a specific product from the inventory by its unique product identifier. It is designed for operations related to product lifecycle management, ensuring that the catalog remains up-to-date and accurate. Users such as inventory managers or store administrators can utilize this API to maintain their product listings effectively. This operation enhances the overall efficiency of product management systems within retail environments.

delete.summary: Delete a specific product by ID.
delete.description: This operation allows you to permanently delete a product identified by its ID from the inventory. Once deleted, the product cannot be recovered.

id.description: The unique identifier of the deleted product.

protocol.description: The protocol used for the API request (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS).

method.description: The HTTP method used for the request, in this case, DELETE.

auth.description: The type of authentication used in the request.

size.description: The size of the request in bytes.

received_bytes.description: The number of bytes received in the response.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the DELETE operation was performed.

data.description: Optional additional data returned with the response.

X-Failure-Mode.description: Indicates the failure mode of the operation, if applicable.
